subject: maths
title: Doubles and bonds
summary: See doubles as two equal parts and recall some bonds to 10.

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 is a bag story with two groups of 4. Q2 asks 10 is double what. Q3 asks what 3 and 3 make. Q4 completes 9 to make 10. Q5 picks a pair for 10. Q6 types half of 8. Q7 orders doubles. Q8 taps every double pair. Q9 matches 4 + 4 to 8. Q10 types half of 4.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy shows doubles as two equal parts the child can build and match. Medium links double to half with sharing. Hard reverses double and half with numerals, plus one story picture that carries the two bags. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not just bigger numbers.
